prompt:
You are an AO workflow planner.
Generate the contents of a WorkflowInstance JSON file for the requested objective.

Return one valid WorkflowInstance JSON object only. No commentary. No wrapping markdown fences around the final answer.
Honor every `guide-contract` block below.
Treat every `guide-template` block as live runtime input.
Treat every `guide-example` block as a shape reference, not as a verbatim copy target.
When required blocks include durable runtime facts or domain decision reports, carry those decisions forward into the updated WorkflowInstance seam and preserve their stable report or payload keys for the next resume step.
Use `block_id` as the stable machine-ingestible lookup key.
For every weave-out transition, include a minimal `evidence_references` manifest in the structured weave-out request or transition payload. Each item must contain a verified workspace-relative or runtime-output-relative `path`, 1-based inclusive `start_line` and `end_line`, and a `role`. Cite the actual successful `guide.<packageversion>.md` output and its output lines when a guide controls the decision; do not cite only guide source prose or list the full context pack.
When the input contains `replan_history`, preserve the blocker, ordered attempted actions and outcomes, event/audit references, terminal business objective, and prior route decisions. Select exactly one explicit replan strategy: `continue_from_current`, `rollback_to_unconfirmed`, `redesign_from_current`, `full_redesign`, or `reversible_workaround`. Return a viable path from the selected anchor to the terminal business outcome; a workaround must include a one-step rollback plan. A completion flag alone is never terminal evidence; require a non-empty `terminal_evidence` object or reference before claiming completion.
Strongly prefer `pythonScript` for multi-step calculations, text shaping, regex work, or batch data transformation.

```guide-contract

order: 0

---

    "guide-contract",
    "guide-example",

  ],

  "treatGuideExampleBlocksAsShapeReferences": true,
  "treatGuideTemplateBlocksAsLiveRuntimeInputs": true,
  "requiredBlockRule": "Every block with consumption_requirement = required must be honored when authoring or editing the WorkflowInstance result.",
  "optionalBlockRule": "Blocks with consumption_requirement = optional are reference-only and may be skipped when they do not help the current authoring move.",
  "finalAnswerShape": "single WorkflowInstance JSON object",
  "finalAnswerAllowsCommentary": false,
  "finalAnswerAllowsMarkdownFence": false
}
```

```guide-contract
    "expr",
    "tbr"
  ],
  "stateTransitionIdsPath": "state.groups[*].transitionIds",
  "transitionTargetField": "targetNodeId",

    "drafting",
    "readyToStart",
    "running",

    "stateUpdate",
    "artifactEmit",
    "memoryRead",
    "memoryWrite"

```

```guide-contract
block_id: workflow.root-field-contract
semantic_role: root-field-contract
title: Workflow Root Field Contract
content_type: application/json
order: 20
consumption_requirement: required
tags: ["workflow","contract"]
---
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "fieldName": "instanceId",
      "semanticRole": "caller-managed workflow identifier",
      "requirement": "Keep stable for the generated or modified file.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "nodes",
      "semanticRole": "node dictionary",
      "requirement": "Serialize every node with the polymorphic kind discriminator and stable ids.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "startNodeId",
      "semanticRole": "entry state",
      "requirement": "Point to the first state node for a new workflow.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "currentNodeId",
      "semanticRole": "current execution state",
      "requirement": "For new files this usually matches startNodeId; for replans it must reflect the current runtime seam.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "endNodeId",
      "semanticRole": "terminal state",
      "requirement": "Point to the intended completion state.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "status",
      "semanticRole": "workflow status",
      "requirement": "Use only allowed workflow status values.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "context",
      "semanticRole": "durable runtime facts",
      "requirement": "Persist planning or execution facts the caller needs across steps.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "history",
      "semanticRole": "execution history",
      "requirement": "Can be empty for a new authored file and should remain coherent for a modified runtime file.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "version",
      "semanticRole": "revision counter",
      "requirement": "Keep as an integer revision field.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    },
    {
      "fieldName": "activeWaitGroups",
      "semanticRole": "wait metadata",
      "requirement": "Populate only when the workflow genuinely requires wait/resume coordination.",
      "requiredForNewWorkflow": true
    }
  ]
}
```
